finding.title: Synthetic integrity fixture demonstrates the impact-gate contract
finding.expected: A synthetic mismatched state is rejected.
finding.observed: The local synthetic fixture accepts the mismatch before its synthetic repair.
finding.impact: The fixture demonstrates a state-integrity failure without touching TRON networks or user data.
finding.action_required: Correct the synthetic validation decision and preserve the regression control.

proof.negative_control: A matching synthetic state remains accepted.
proof.remediation_control: The repaired synthetic fixture rejects the mismatched state.

root_cause.invariant: A referenced digest must bind the accepted synthetic state.
root_cause.trust_boundary: Synthetic untrusted state input enters the validation decision.
root_cause.faulty_decision: The synthetic decision trusts a locator without binding digest equality.
root_cause.minimal_fix: Require digest equality before the synthetic state can be accepted.
